svg.title: C13-M02-F3: LDAP bind choices
svg.desc: Three LDAP bind options ranked from a cleartext simple bind to protect, through a TLS-protected simple bind, to the preferred GSSAPI bind that uses a Kerberos ticket.
svg.text: simple bind + no TLS : DN + password in CLEARTEXT (avoid)
simple bind + LDAPS : DN + password inside TLS (acceptable)
SASL/GSSAPI (Kerberos) : uses the TGT, NO password (preferred)
Figure C13-M02-F3. Prefer SASL/GSSAPI; never send a simple bind without TLS.
